{{Quote|Th&hellip; This invasion wasn't my idea!|The Neimoidian controller, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="PMvg" />}}
A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] '''controller''' worked for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Their job was to monitor the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay of the [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|cargo freighter]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']]. During the Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], they worked in a small [[Computer/Legends|computer]] room in the ''Saak'ak''. However, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had arrived on the ''Saak'ak'' to negotiate an end to the blockade, was searching for a way to escape from the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] after surviving an [[Death/Legends|assassination]] attempt perpetrated by [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].

The Jedi found his way to the room the Neimoidian controller was working in, and questioned them about the means to pass through the security door in the ''Saak'ak''{{'s}} hangar. The concerned Neimoidian stated that it was not possible to open the door while the power generator was functioning, so Kenobi decided to destroy the generator. After the generator was destroyed, the Neimoidian asked Kenobi to leave, and the Jedi complied.

==Biography==
===Controller of the power generators===
{{Quote|What are you doing here?''"<br />"''I'm monitoring the power generators in the hangar bay.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and the Neimoidian controller|<ref name="PMvg" />}}
[[File:NeimoidianController2.jpg|thumb|left|350px|The Neimoidian controller inside the power generator control room]]
A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] worked for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] as a controller of the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay of the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']], a [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]]. When the Federation [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was initiated<ref name="PMvg" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the ''Saak'ak'' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the many ''Lucrehulk''-class [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] that surrounded the world. During the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], the Neimoidian monitored the power generators in a small room full of [[Computer/Legends|computers]] alongside an [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] and three [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]].<ref name="PMvg" />

The Neimoidian continued their work on the ''Saak'ak'' when the Trade Federation launched its invasion of Naboo. Only moments after the beginning of the invasion, however, the room was found by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The Jedi had arrived on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to negotiate a solution between the Federation and Naboo, but [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] attempted to [[Death/Legends|assassinate]] the young Jedi. Kenobi managed to escape from the assassination attempt and tried to reach the hangar to escape from the ship. Sighting Kenobi, the panicked Neimoidian quickly shut the [[Blast door/Legends|metal door]] to their room, sealing themselves inside and leaving the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to fight Kenobi. The Jedi destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], entered the room, and confronted the horrified controller, who begged for mercy.<ref name="PMvg" />

===Destruction of the power generator===
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)}}
{{Quote|How can I reach the hangar?''"<br />"''It's beyond the red security door. But you'll never open the door while its power source is intact.''"<br />"''I must find a way to cut the doors power.''"<br />"''No! Don't touch the power generator!|Obi-Wan Kenobi and the Neimoidian controller|<ref name="PMvg" />}}
[[File:NeimoidianController3.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The Neimoidian controller is questioned by Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]
The apprehensive Neimoidian controller quickly explained to Kenobi that they had not planned the invasion. Kenobi asked them how to get to the hangar, but the Neimoidian revealed that it was past a [[Color|red]] security door which could not be opened while its power source was intact. Kenobi then questioned the controller about their work in the room, and the Neimoidian replied that they were monitoring the power generators of the hangar bay.<ref name="PMvg" />

Kenobi continued the interrogation, but when he asked how he could destroy the security door's power source, the nervous Neimoidian lied that the power generators were indestructible. Kenobi nevertheless decided to find a way to cut the door's power off by destroying the generator, which caused the appalled Neimoidian controller to yell at him and order him not to touch the machine.<ref name="PMvg" />
{{Endgame}}

However, Kenobi found the power generator inside the room and destroyed it with his lightsaber, causing the security door to open. The Neimoidian controller asked the Jedi to leave, and Kenobi complied, leaving the room to rejoin his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="PMvg" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ahhh! Don't hurt me!|The Neimoidian controller, when approached by Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="PMvg" />}}
[[File:NeimoidianController4.jpg|thumb|left|95px|The Neimoidian controller]]
Working in a small computer room, the Neimoidian controller monitored the power generators of the ''Saak'ak''{{'s}} hangar bay. They were very frightened by Kenobi and tried to lock themselves inside the control room when he first saw the Jedi. When this failed, the Neimoidian begged for their life, asking Kenobi not to hurt them. 

During Kenobi's questioning, the Neimoidian answered him quickly; however, when asked about the means to destroy the power generator, the concerned controller lied to Kenobi, telling him that the generators were indestructible. Seemingly terrified by Kenobi's plan to destroy the generator, the Neimoidian tried in vain to convince the Jedi not to touch it. After the generator was destroyed, the controller only wanted to be left alone. The Neimoidian had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and mottled green skin.<ref name="PMvg" />

==Equipment==
The Neimoidian wore a tall black hat and blue robes that had a white material that covered their chest.<ref name="PMvg" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Aaaigh!|The Neimoidian controller, if killed by Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="PMvg" />}}
[[File:JeffCoopwood.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Neimoidian was voiced by Jeff Coopwood (pictured).]]
The Neimoidian was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> released on [[May 3]], [[1999]],<ref name="Cargo Bay">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/889|text=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] adaptation&mdash;released on [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] on [[May 18]], 1999<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/1999/05/18/star-wars-hits-the-shelves|text=Star Wars Hits The Shelves|author=IGN Staff|date=1999-05-18|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20121121210047}}</ref>&mdash;of the [[prequel trilogy]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|film of the same name]], which premiered on [[May 19]], 1999.<ref name="TPM date">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The character was voiced by [[Jeff Coopwood]], who also provided the voice of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka]] in the [[Star Wars video games|game]].<ref name="PMvg" /> The character resembles [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]], a character from the film,<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> but is only credited as "Neimoidian controller."<ref name="PMvg" />

In the game, the Neimoidian is encountered in the first level by Obi-Wan Kenobi, who is controlled by the player. Kenobi does not have to interact with the Neimoidian in any way and can even kill the unarmed being, which has no effect on the game. Due to this, and the fact the player has several dialogue options, whether the conversation between the Jedi and the Neimoidian is actually [[canon]]ical&mdash;and, if it is, the exact form in which it transpires&mdash;is ambiguous. This article assumes 100% game completion with no "[[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]" options.<ref name="PMvg" /> The strategy guide advises the player to talk to the technician.<ref name="Prima" /> Regardless, the power generator must be destroyed by the player to continue.<ref name="PMvg" />
